title: i3blocks: left-click on ⏻/🎮 opens the daily-limits popup
objective: A left-click on either block launches `daily-limits --gui` even though i3blocks' PATH lacks ~/.local/bin, and a missing launcher is reported instead of ignored.
acceptance_criteria: With PATH=/usr/bin:/bin and BLOCK_BUTTON=1 both blocks run $DAILY_LIMITS_BIN --gui
The three i3blocks test suites pass and pre-commit is clean
